name: Tatebe Kikyou
source: The current head of the Tatebe-style school of Japanese dance. Her exquisite movements and elegant manner charm anyone laying eyes on her. She's tall and has a voluptuous figure, her hobbies include an interest in traditional Japanese martial arts. She's married but doesn't have children. She's usually a quiet and reserved wife, but beneath the mask hides another facet of her which is interested in sex and depravingly lewd.
